summary: Full frontend redesign verification (R1-R11) on public homepage. All 11 acceptance criteria pass on desktop 1440, tablet 768 and mobile 390. Logo mark geometry matches brand board (arc + 3 petals, plum center, deep green sides, nothing crosses below arc). Wordmark is Fraunces Variable 600 with correct two-tone (green #0F3D2E / plum #6F4B8B). Hero shows white lilies with correct eyebrow, H1 (56px/36px) and decorative stacked serif words. Trust strip is white with circular green-outlined icons and 4 correct titles. How-it-works has 5 plum step circles with unchanged copy. Solutions cards all 3 present with correct testids and images loading. Features section has all 6 unchanged titles. Dark band #0F3D2E with correct h2 and lilies image. Stats row strings ('1,200+', '500+', '300+', 'VERIFIED SUPPLIERS') absent. Footer dark green with /privacy and /terms links. No horizontal overflow at any breakpoint. Mobile hamburger opens showing all nav links + Sign in. Zero pageerrors on /, /login, /register, /privacy, /terms.
critical_code_review_comments: PublicHomePage.tsx uses fetchpriority spread hack via {...{fetchpriority: 'high'}} - functional but not typed; consider React 19 typing for fetchPriority attribute.

Hero image hosted on Pexels/Unsplash CDNs — occasional 429 rate-limit responses observed under rapid reload (test environment noise, not user-facing). Consider self-hosting/caching key marketing images for reliability.
Logo.tsx defines brand colors as hard-coded consts (GREEN/PLUM/GREEN_LIGHT/PLUM_LIGHT) duplicating CSS vars in public.css — extract to a shared brand tokens module to keep the two in sync.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_25 verified full brand-board redesign R1-R11 on / homepage. All checks passed. Verified data points: logo-mark-svg paths exactly match ARC/PETAL_LEFT/PETAL_RIGHT/BLOOM constants; wordmark computed font-family starts with 'Fraunces Variable' weight 600 at 33.6px desktop / 24.8px mobile; H1 rendered 56px desktop / 36px mobile; step circles rgb(111,75,139); band bg rgb(15,61,46); footer bg rgb(15,61,46); no forbidden stats strings; no horizontal overflow at 1440/768/390; hamburger works; /login /register /privacy /terms all return 200 with no page errors. Login page logo lives in AuthLayout with testid 'auth-logo-img' (uses same Logo component, so wordmark styling is identical). No fixes applied.
